# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 98 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 51 | Coptic

---

## Saying 98

Jesus said: "The Father's kingdom is like someone who wanted to kill a powerful man. Back at home, he drew his sword and drove it into the wall — testing whether his arm was up to the task. Then he went and killed the powerful man."

---

**Translator's Notes (PNEUMA):**

- "Back at home" — the private preparation before the public act
- "Drove it into the wall" — the violence of the test
- "Whether his arm was up to the task" — physical and volitional readiness
- The assassin parable is preserved in its shocking completeness
